hero.kicker: Handcrafted Pure Cotton Bedding · Gurgaon Atelier
hero.headline: The touch of pure cotton, woven for serene mornings.
hero.subheadline: Welcome to Cotton Nest. Discover our curated collection of King size bedsheets — tailored from 100% natural long-staple cotton with breathable comfort, delicate florals, and subtle muted golden accents.

story.heading: Honest pure cotton, tailored for Indian bedrooms.
story.paragraph1: At Cotton Nest, based in Sector 46 Gurgaon, we started with a simple belief: bedsheets should never be made with sweaty synthetic microfiber or shrunk down to stingy sizes that untuck the moment you turn in bed.
story.paragraph2: Every single bedsheet in our collection is cut to an expansive King size (108×108 / 100×108 inch), guaranteeing a generous tuck-in under even the thickest modern orthopaedic mattresses.
story.pillar1Desc: Zero polyester blends. Completely breathable and cool against the skin during Indian summers.
story.pillar2Desc: Expansive 108×108 inch proportion ensures mattress corners remain neatly tucked all night.
story.pillar3Desc: Wash after domestic wash, florals and geometric linework retain their rich clarity.
story.pillar4Desc: Direct support, prompt exchange assistance, and open touch-and-feel visits in Sector 46.

reviews.title: Pure cotton breathability & genuine 108×108 inch King size drop
reviews.comment: I visited their Sector 46 atelier in Gurgaon before buying. Most brands claim King size but give 90x100 which pulls out of a 10-inch mattress. This bedsheet has a huge, generous tuck-in on all four sides. The rose block prints are subtle and soothing, not garish at all. Machine washed twice, zero shrinkage or color bleeding.

reviews.title: Subtle vintage elegance, makes bedroom look like a boutique hotel
reviews.comment: The sage mint color is so calming. What impressed me the most is the zero-polyester natural feel. In Gurgaon summers you can immediately tell pure cotton from poly-cotton blends. This stays cool all night. The matching pillow shams with piped borders look very luxurious.

reviews.title: Crisp percale weave with cheerful golden marigold accents
reviews.comment: Ordered via WhatsApp after founder shared unboxing video. Delivery was prompt. The fabric has that crisp, crisp luxury hotel bed feeling and softens up beautifully upon wash. Pillow covers have secure flap tucks so the pillows don't slide out.

reviews.title: Organic botanical aesthetic with checkered pillow shams
reviews.comment: The contrast between the warm milky white poppy field and the sage green checkered pillow covers is perfection. It gives a cottagecore, artisanal Indian feel without being overwhelming. Delivered all the way to Bengaluru in pristine box packaging.

reviews.title: Heavyweight combed cotton that stays wrinkle-free on the bed
reviews.comment: This bedsheet has great weight to it. The chevron trellis pattern with subtle golden linework looks very modern. Slept on it for a week and it barely creased. Will definitely pick up 2 more sets for our guest rooms.

reviews.title: Artisanal Sanganeri block print with deep, fade-resistant teal
reviews.comment: I was looking for authentic Rajasthani block print style without scratchy starch or color bleed. Hand washed the first time with salt water as suggested - absolutely zero color bleeding! The indigo-teal shade is rich and majestic.

reviews.title: Bought locally in Sector 46 - centerpiece looks stunning on king bed
reviews.comment: Living right in Sector 46, I walked into their house atelier. The owner was extremely courteous and let me unfold the sheets to check the weave. The central floral motif lands right in the middle of our 6.5x6.5 bed. Incredible value at ₹1000.

reviews.title: Vibrant royal cobalt blue, gingham pillow covers are a treat
reviews.comment: The blue rose print against crisp white gives such a fresh, clean look to the bedroom. The pillow shams with gingham checks are super stylish. 100% natural cotton that feels cool against the skin.

reviews.title: Authentic garland symmetry, soothing natural cream tone
reviews.comment: Hailing from Jaipur, I am very picky about bedsheet fabric quality. Cotton Nest has nailed the combed cotton texture. The antique pink and soft apricot blossoms create such a tranquil atmosphere in the room.
